newsitem.title: USA: Turner Group acquires oil, gas interests.
newsitem.headline: Turner Group acquires oil, gas interests.

text.p: Turner Group Inc said it has acquired Secondary Oil Corp, New Mexico, and Secondary Oil Corp, Arkansas; and the working interest owned by Precise Development Inc in those projects for more than $7 million in cash and stock.
The acquisition gives Turner ownership in more than 1,200 oil and gas wells in three states, the company said.

It said the acquisition in New Mexico, Texas and Arkansas provided Turner with more than 30,000 acres of production with proven reserves in excess of 170 million barrels of oil and 16 billion cubic feet of natural gas.
The company said production now exceeds 8,000 barrels of oil and gas 1O million cubic feet of natural gas per month.
Turner said it is committed to investing $500,000 to $1 million in order to increase oil production to 30,000 barrels of oil and 25 million cubic feet of gas per month.
